They are the greatest little animals that I&#8217;ve ever known (yes, I&#8217;m biased). They have no idea what to do with a bone, but give them a carrot/cucumber/pear/apple, they are in heaven. Whenever I eat any of these things, they come and sit in front of me and watch, all the while their little noses twitching, sniffing the air waiting for the food to drop. They&#8217;re so cute I can die.
